title: Identifying the band in his father's photo: Raleigh's band, Albert-system clarinet
summary: They discuss the instruments and players in the photo, identify the band as Emil Raleigh's and name the bass and drums players.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: And let's see, this picture here, this band is, is that one that you were in or your father? No, my father. That's my father here. Oh, the one sitting in the middle of the sax, alto sax. Yeah, and the clarinet. That's my father. And the clarinet. Yes, I see he has the clarinet standing there. I can't see the picture, it's a little bit dim. Did he play Albert System or Bane System? I think that was a C.G.
Conron, I don't know, I think that's an Albert System we had, the clarinet.
That's an Albert System. That's Albert. Yeah, Albert System.
Do you know whose band this was? No, I think that was Raleigh.
Some girl on piano, isn't it? I don't know the girl's name, but the trumpet player is Raleigh. That's the guy in the band.
Do you know his, was that his last name?
His last name, Raleigh. What would it be? Emil, Emil Raleigh. Emil Raleigh. Emil. Emil Raleigh.
And as a trombonist, do you happen to know who he is? Or anybody else there that you might remember?
No, I don't know. I know that drummer, his name was McGee. And Al, you know this guy, the bass player, he used to play with, you think he's playing bass with Larry now.
That's August Lanois. August Lanois. And that's old McGee used to play the doibell all the time. Yeah, that's McGee. I don't know.

I think his name was Willie McGee. I wasn't sure. We played together a time too. We played together a time too. August Lanois. From the turbo. Gabriel and Fredl. I played with a lot of fellas that my daddy used to play with. I played with a lot of guys. All them old fellas. Yeah. Papa Celestan Dan. I was with that band for four years.
Do you know who the banjo is? The banjo?
No, I don't know him. I really don't know him.
And this band played in New Orleans then mostly? Yeah, sure.
That's one of the bands that's next to Papa Celestan band at that time.
